integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Modern science-documentary 2D math animation, deep navy blue background, crisp white mathematical typography, glowing cyan-blue curves, orange accent markers, minimal clean composition with no decorative clutter. A small white sphere rolls steadily to the right along a thin horizontal track across the lower third of the frame; the camera tracks right with it at a slow, even speed while faint time tick marks slide past in the background, and a smooth cyan position-versus-time curve begins drawing itself upward behind the sphere. An off-screen Chinese narrator (S1) says in a calm off-screen voiceover: <d>[Chinese] 微积分研究的是变化。</d> A Chinese subtitle reads "微积分研究的是变化。"

[Shot 2] At 00:01.700, the camera cuts to a full-frame 2D Cartesian coordinate system with thin white axes, a smooth cyan curve rising from lower left to upper right, and two marked points on that curve labeled "A" and "B". A straight white secant line is drawn through both points, and a small orange right-angle slope marker appears at its lower end. Point B then slides steadily along the curve toward A, the secant line pivoting smoothly with it until it settles as an orange tangent line that touches the curve only at A. White on-screen formula text appears in the upper right in sequence: "平均变化率 = [s(t + Δt) − s(t)] / Δt", then "v(t) = ds/dt". The narrator continues off-screen: <d>[Chinese] Δt 趋近零，得瞬时速度。</d> A Chinese subtitle reads "Δt 趋近零，得瞬时速度。"

[Shot 3] At 00:03.300, the camera cuts to a 2D plot on white axes showing the straight line y = x from x = 0 to x = 4, with the region beneath the line faintly tinted. A row of equal-width thin cyan rectangles under the line multiplies in number as each individual rectangle becomes narrower, their top edges stepping closer to the line, while a thin orange sliver of the remaining gap appears near x = 2. White on-screen formula text appears in the upper right: "A = ∫₀⁴ x dx = 8". The narrator continues off-screen: <d>[Chinese] 微小量累加，得积分。</d> A Chinese subtitle reads "微小量累加，得积分。"

overall_soundscape: A soft dry rolling hum of the sphere along the track, a light airy sweep as the camera tracks right, a faint synthetic pen-stroke tone as the curve and the secant line draw themselves, and a subtle low pulse as the rectangles multiply and narrow. No voice or music inside the ambience.

non_diegetic_music: A minimal ambient electronic bed with a slow steady pulse and a soft high shimmer, kept low in the mix so the narration stays clear.
